dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Nebula is on the at-risk list for medical concerns. Nebula is severely underweight with recurrent weight loss, current anorexia, and severe dental disease. Despite previously unremarkable bloodwork and a period of improved appetite and weight gain, his recent decline raises concern for significant underlying chronic disease, including possible neoplasia or terminal illness. Dental disease may contribute to his current anorexia but is unlikely to fully explain his history of poor body condition alongside adequate appetite. Nebula requires urgent placement for further evaluation and supportive care. Behaviorally, he is tolerant of handling and medical care.
dog.name: Nebula
